# Intake baselines

`manifest.json` pins generated baselines for registered charts whose fixtures do
not exist in an older comparison commit. The battery reads the commit's fixture
when present. An absent path requires exactly one record for the resolved commit
and fixture, matching the producer's recipe and complete input digest and the
schema bytes. Each record also pins the generating executable's SHA-256.

DaskHub 2024.1.1 was fetched from `https://helm.dask.org`, with JupyterHub 3.2.1
and Dask Gateway 2024.1.0 as packaged. Each baseline was generated by a frozen
release CLI built from the record's commit, using the vendored provider bundle:

```sh
helm-schema testdata/charts/daskhub --offline --exclude-tests \
  --k8s-version v1.35.0 \
  --k8s-schema-cache-dir testdata/provider-bundle/kubernetes-json-schema-cache \
  --crd-catalog-cache-dir testdata/provider-bundle/crds-catalog-cache \
  --output baseline.schema.json
```

The two records cover the pinned roster baseline and the lint-required change's
main baseline. Updating chart files, providers, or generation options requires
re-deriving these baselines from their recorded source commits.

The DaskHub fixture's recipe selects the vendored 1.35 provider so its
non-nullable dependency fields expose the lint-required regression. The older
default corpus provider permits null for those fields and hides the failure.

The provider bundle's `traefik.io/middleware_v1alpha1.json` comes from the
`Middleware` version `v1alpha1`'s `schema.openAPIV3Schema` in the packaged
`charts/dask-gateway/crds/traefik.yaml`. It supplies the offline validator for the
two default middleware resources DaskHub renders.
